commitResults.messageTitle: Echo user commands and exit on bye
Add support for storing and listing tasks
Add typed task support and UI test workflow
commitResults.messageBody:
Introduce Todo, Deadline, and Event subclasses so the task list can
store and display each task type polymorphically.

Record console UI test cases and transcripts, and require future code
changes to update and run the UI test plan.

Replace repeated command literals and numeric substring offsets with named syntax tokens. This makes the parser easier to read and keeps the extraction boundaries aligned with the command grammar when the UI syntax changes.

Move welcome output and individual command actions out of main so the loop only reads, dispatches, and retains task state. This keeps each method at one level of abstraction and makes command behavior easier to locate and change safely.

commitResults.messageTitle: Handle invalid user commands with exceptions Add custom SandyException handling for empty task descriptions, malformed commands, invalid task numbers, missing tasks, and unknown commands. Update the UI test plan to cover error handling and continued command processing.
Organize classes into suitable Java packages Move task classes into sandy.task and the custom exception into sandy.exception, while keeping Sandy in the root sandy package.

commitResults.messageBody:
Allow users to remove tasks by their list number and report the updated
task count.

Replace the fixed-size task array with an ArrayList to support dynamic
addition and removal while keeping task numbering consistent.

Save task changes to a relative data file and reload them when Sandy
starts so users retain their task list across sessions.

Create missing data directories automatically and handle malformed saved
data without preventing the application from starting.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract application components and command classes
commitResults.messageBody:
Separate console interaction, task-list management, and command parsing
  from Sandy. Represent each supported operation with a Command subclass
  so Sandy can delegate execution through one shared interface. This
  reduces the responsibilities of the main class and makes commands
  easier to extend independently.

commitResults.messageTitle: Parse and store deadline dates and times
commitResults.messageBody:
Represent deadline values as LocalDateTime instead of free-form text.
  Accept ISO dates, ISO date-times, and day/month/year values with
  24-hour times. Display deadlines in a readable format and persist them
  as ISO values so they can be loaded reliably. Reject invalid dates with
  a clear error and cover parsing, display, persistence, and reload in the
  UI test plan.

Introduce a find command that matches keywords against task
  descriptions without changing task state. Return results in task-list
  order and display a matching-results heading when no tasks match.
  Reject empty search terms and cover matching, no-match, and empty-term
  behavior in the UI test plan.

commitResults.messageTitle: Document public and non-trivial private methods
commitResults.messageBody:
Add Javadocs to every undocumented public or protected method and
  non-trivial private helper. Complete the project’s JavaDoc stretch goal
  and keep the existing UI test transcripts current.

Document how to launch Sandy and use its task commands, including
  deadline formats, event values, search behavior, and automatic saving.
